exact_real_reference.caveat: Exact arithmetic identity; need removed item contribution, nonempty remaining mass and a usable anchor. Not a FLOAT32 native subtraction equivalence.

rounded_state_collision.conclusion: The same rounded (m,l,a), even with the same removed item, can correspond to different remaining outputs. This summary alone cannot support exact eviction; retained per-item data or a reread/recompute/certified representation is needed.
rounded_state_collision.scope: Declared FLOAT32 round-to-nearest scalar summary model, not actual C8 values or a claim against every possible native/augmented state.

provisional_BF16_rebase.scope: Finite round-to-nearest BF16/FLOAT32 reference away from BF16 ties, not a measured CANN Exp/CAST_ROUND or SoftmaxFlashV2 result. Changing final selected tile/anchor can cross a quantization boundary.

conclusion: Speculate per-item QK/logits rather than blindly accumulating provisional PV. Replay the final chronological tile/softmax/BF16/PV contract, or declare and prove a changed precision domain.
